overall: The AG found the Lowell School Committee violated the OML because members certified receipt of the materials after the two-week deadline; intent was not found, the clerk allegations were declined, and only future compliance was ordered.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged that Committee members failed to certify receipt of Open Meeting Law materials within two weeks of taking office.
allegations.key_passage: Because Committee members did not certify receipt of the Open Meeting Law materials within two weeks of qualification for office, we find that the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Lowell City Clerk violated the Open Meeting Law by not delivering the materials to members and not retaining their certificates.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we decline to review any separate allegation that the Lowell City Clerk also violated the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainant asserted the certification violation was intentional, citing prior OML determinations against the Committee.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we decline to find the violation intentional.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law,
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
